Radioactive.Name: Radioactive
Radioactive.Description: Give your knife a radioactive effect and turn your victims green.

Electric.Name: Electric Knife
Electric.Description: Zap your enemies and turn them into skeletons!

PinkFire.Name: Pink Flaming Knife
PinkFire.Description: Set your knife on (pink) fire and burn your enemies!

BlueFire.Name: Blue Flaming Knife
BlueFire.Description: Set your knife on (blue) fire and burn your enemies!

Musical.Name: Musical
Musical.Description: Give your knife a musical effect. No kill effect.

GearStorm.Name: Gear Storm
GearStorm.Description: Unleash the Gear Storm on your enemies!

Darkfire.Name: Darkfire
Darkfire.Description: Engulf your enemies in the flames of darkness.

Knifeception.Name: Knifeception
Knifeception.Description: Your knife spawns mini knives! Changes based on your equipped knife.

Burn.Name: Flaming Knife
Burn.Description: Set your knife on fire and burn your enemies!

Ghostify.Name: Ghostify
Ghostify.Description: Give your knife a ghostly effect, and turn your victims into ghosts!

GreenFire.Name: Green Flaming Knife
GreenFire.Description: Set your knife on (green) fire and burn your enemies!

Heartify.Name: Heartify
Heartify.Description: Heartify your knife and give your victims hearteyes.

ChocolateMilk.Name: Chocolate Milk
ChocolateMilk.Description: Relax after a long day of unboxing crates with a cool glass of chocolate milk.

SprayPaint.Name: Spray Paint
SprayPaint.Description: Spray paint your favorite decals on the walls.

Fireflies.Name: Firefly Jar
Fireflies.Description: Light up the room with a jar of fireflies.

Teddy.Name: Teddy Bear
Teddy.Description: He will always love you forever.

FakeBomb.Name: Prank Bomb
FakeBomb.Description: Prank your friends with this confetti bomb!

Xray.Name: X-Ray
Xray.Description: See through walls for a few seconds. 30s cooldown.

FakeGun.Name: Fake Gun
FakeGun.Description: Trick innocents by making your knife look like a gun temporarily.

Footsteps.Description: Allows you to see the footprints of innocents.
Footsteps.Name: Footsteps

Haste.Name: Haste
Haste.Description: You move 30% faster while holding the knife out. This allows you to outrun innocents.

Ghost.Name: Ghost
Ghost.Description: Go invisible for a few seconds.
